trust_decision.summary: Mint.HTTP1 decides how a server response body is framed (chunked / content-length / until-close) and whether the connection may be reused for pipelined responses; at the pinned commit it applies chunked framing when chunked is the FIRST transfer coding and keeps HTTP/1.0 keep-alive connections with Transfer-Encoding open.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'chunked framing when chunked is not the final transfer coding'; the only place chunked framing is selected is message_body's `"chunked" == List.first(request.transfer_encoding)` clause.

fix_sites.entry_point: Mint.HTTP1.stream/2 and Mint.HTTP1.recv/3 (via handle_data -> decode(:body) -> message_body)
Mint.HTTP1.stream/2, recv/3 (request_done after every completed response)
Mint.HTTP1.stream/2 with {:tcp_closed,_}/{:ssl_closed,_}; recv/3 on closed socket
fix_sites.module_kind: core close handling (until_closed completion, pipelined requests)

fix_sites.entry_point: Mint.HTTP1.stream/2, recv/3 (parsing bytes after a completed response)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published source changes are in lib/mint/http1.ex (fix.diff:625-787). Mint.TunnelProxy reaches the same parser via HTTP1.stream (lib/mint/tunnel_proxy.ex:78) but CONNECT 2xx ignores TE (lib/mint/http1.ex:1209-1210), so it is not a real out-of-scope site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The 1xx informational path (lib/mint/http1.ex:828-845) resets transfer_encoding to [] and never calls request_done, so a solver can argue 'interim responses have no body, framing does not apply' and leave HTTP/1.0 1xx+Transfer-Encoding unclosed; likewise the leftover bytes after a close-delimiting response (lib/mint/http1.ex:1036-1044, 557-567) look like a pipelining bug, not the framing flaw.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Chunked must still be decoded when chunked is the final coding after other codings ('gzip, chunked', 'custom, chunked', or 'identity' then 'chunked' in separate fields); HTTP/1.0 keep-alive responses with Content-Length must keep the connection open and pipelined responses parsed; successful CONNECT (incl. HTTP/1.0) must keep the tunnel open. Rejecting any non-plain TE or closing on any TE/HTTP-1.0 breaks these.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: lib/mint/http1.ex:1122-1125, lib/mint/http1.ex:1140-1143, lib/mint/http1.ex:1151-1152; tests fix.diff:796-830, fix.diff:912-935, fix.diff:962-981

O6_input_shapes: single Transfer-Encoding field with comma list where chunked is not last ('chunked, gzip')
chunked in an earlier Transfer-Encoding field and another coding in a later field (fields accumulated at lib/mint/http1.ex:1124)
chunked final after other codings, single field or several fields (must stay chunked)
HTTP/1.0 final response with Connection: keep-alive and Transfer-Encoding (chunked or 'gzip, chunked')
pipelined bytes following a close-delimited (until_closed) or connection-closing response
requests queued behind a response that closes the connection (Connection: close, HTTP/1.0, until_closed)

O7_producer.where: lib/mint/http1.ex:1122-1125 (store_header appends each Transfer-Encoding field's tokens) with lib/mint/http1/parse.ex:120-122; reset for 1xx at lib/mint/http1.ex:839

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Outgoing streamed requests treat the request body as caller-chunked when 'chunked' appears anywhere in the user's Transfer-Encoding tokens, not only as the final coding.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same membership-vs-final-position test as the response bug, written in the request-encoding helper; a maintainer reusing token-list membership would plausibly write it (direction variant, so weak lever).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second persistence decision for interim responses that resets response-side fields (including transfer_encoding) before any close decision.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already the real shape at the pinned commit; a how-type site because the reset erases the state the request_done check depends on.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Continuation that keeps decoding buffered bytes as the next pipelined response even after the connection state became :closed.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: next_request only checks request == nil; adding a state check is easy to forget when close is decided in a different helper (request_done/internal_close).

O9_family: HTTP/1 response smuggling / message-framing parser differential (CWE-444): transfer-coding order and HTTP/1.0 persistence

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change List.first to List.last (or reject non-final chunked) in message_body at lib/mint/http1.ex:1215 and stop, missing HTTP/1.0+TE persistence, the 1xx path, and leftover-byte/pipelined handling after close.

out_of_scope_notes: Response header decoding uses :erlang.decode_packet(:httph_bin) (lib/mint/http1/response.ex:22-39); obs-fold / whitespace handling of the Transfer-Encoding name is a separate parser-differential question, not pursued.
Request-side TE handling at lib/mint/http1.ex:1305 uses membership not final position; caller-controlled request direction, outside this advisory's response-framing protection.
